outcome: success of trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: The study included 1179 women with a prior cesarean section who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) at Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital in Southeast China between January 2016 and January 2018.
finding: Maternal height, abdominal circumference, ultrasound-estimated fetal weight, and history of vaginal delivery were independently associated with successful VBAC, with no significant differences observed in adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes between successful and unsuccessful TOLAC groups.
mod_finding: Maternal height, abdominal circumference, ultrasound-estimated fetal weight, and history of vaginal delivery were identified as key factors influencing the success of vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC).
